```{r load-data}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(showtext)
library(scales)

# 閮剖?銝剜?摮?
font_add("TC", "msjh.ttc") # 雿輻敺株?甇??擃??交Mac?舀??"STHeiti Light.ttc" ? "PingFang TC"
showtext_auto()

# 摰儔???ggplot 銝剜?銝駁?
theme_tc <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_family = "TC") +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "TC"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey40"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

# 霈??撟游漲鞈? (雿輻?詨?頝臬?)
```

# 1. ?梁憭?摰嗅滬?風撌亙?嚗蜓閬憿扳撘?頛?
```{r care-before-hiring}
# ?蔥鞈?
care_long <- bind_rows(
  data109 %>% transmute(year = "109", option = q4),
  data110 %>% transmute(year = "110", option = q4),
  data111 %>% transmute(year = "111", option = q4),
  data112 %>% transmute(year = "112", option = q2),
  data113 %>% transmute(year = "113", option = q2)
) %>%
  mutate(
    option = as.numeric(option),
    year = factor(year, levels = c("109", "110", "111", "112", "113")),
    option_label = case_when(
      option == 1 ~ "?勗振鈭箇憿?,
      option == 2 ~ "?暹??霅?,
      option == 3 ~ "??扳?瑽?,
      option == 4 ~ "隢扛?憿?,
      option == 5 ~ "?暹?鼠??,
      option == 6 ~ "?嗡?",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    option_label = factor(
      option_label,
      levels = c("?勗振鈭箇憿?, "?暹??霅?, "??扳?瑽?,
                 "隢扛?憿?, "?暹?鼠??, "?嗡?")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(option_label))

# 閮?瘥?
care_summary <- care_long %>%
  count(year, option_label, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = n / sum(n),
    percent_label = paste0(round(percent * 100, 1), "%")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 蝜芾ˊ?瑟???ggplot(care_summary, aes(x = option_label, y = percent, fill = year)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.65) +
  geom_text(aes(label = percent_label),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
            vjust = -0.3, size = 3, family = "TC") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#1f3e79", "#5c7cfa", "#52b788", "#f59f00", "#d9480f")) +
  labs(
    title = "109??13 撟游?典?蝐振摨剔?霅瑕極?蜓閬憿扳撘?靘?,
    x = "?折“?孵?", y = "瘥?", fill = "撟港遢"
  ) +
  theme_tc()
```

# 2. ?桀?瘝??梁憭?摰嗅滬?風撌交?嚗蜓閬隞?獢?
```{r alternative-options}
alt_long <- bind_rows(
  data109 %>% transmute(year = "109", option = q5),
  data110 %>% transmute(year = "110", option = q5),
  data111 %>% transmute(year = "111", option = q5),
  data112 %>% transmute(year = "112", option = q3),
  data113 %>% transmute(year = "113", option = q3)
) %>%
  mutate(
    option = as.numeric(option),
    year = factor(year, levels = c("109", "110", "111", "112", "113")),
    option_label = case_when(
      option == 1 ~ "?勗振鈭箇憿?,
      option == 2 ~ "隢扛?憿?,
      option == 3 ~ "?暹??霅?,
      option == 4 ~ "??扳?瑽?,
      option == 5 ~ "?砍?撟怠",
      option == 6 ~ "?嗡?",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    option_label = factor(
      option_label,
      levels = c("?勗振鈭箇憿?, "隢扛?憿?, "?暹??霅?,
                 "??扳?瑽?, "?砍?撟怠", "?嗡?")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(option_label))

alt_summary <- alt_long %>%
  count(year, option_label, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = n / sum(n),
    percent_label = paste0(round(percent * 100, 1), "%")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(alt_summary, aes(x = option_label, y = percent, fill = year)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.65) +
  geom_text(aes(label = percent_label),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
            vjust = -0.3, size = 3, family = "TC") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#1f3e79", "#5c7cfa", "#52b788", "#f59f00", "#d9480f")) +
  labs(
    title = "109??13 撟港蜓閬隞?獢?靘?,
    x = "?蹂誨?寞?", y = "瘥?", fill = "撟港遢"
  ) +
  theme_tc()
```
